title: Context engineering
subtitle: Build the information environment that makes the next model action reliable.
goal: Build the reading packet for the next model decision
intro: Context includes much more than retrieved documents, and every added piece competes for attention and space.
terms: Information in the current model request
A record of included material and its purpose
case: A long conversation mixes a new address, an old draft, and a failed tool call.
The next model call must know what is current, confirmed, and unresolved.
A compact summary can falsely turn a proposed change into a completed one.
